response.evidence: Metadata-only NFC diagnostic implementation in NfcCoordinator.kt successfully records up to 20 read reports in private SharedPreferences ('nfc-read-diagnostics') containing UID, capacity, writability, technology list, and SHA-256 summaries of discovery-cache and active-RF NDEF messages without raw payload exposure or write algorithm modification. Active RF reads exclusively drive state machine reconciliation. Null-read wording in decodeSingleOpenSpool neutralizes previous unverified assumptions ('No NDEF message returned by this read. This does not establish whether an earlier write persisted.'). Build and test suites (StorageAcceptanceTest, 9 tests) assemble, lint, and pass with zero failures.
